name: Carolina Bird Club Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants from a birding club for conservation actions that address the needs of a bird species or group of species in the Carolinas, applied for by a conservation organisation. Construction work is generally excluded.
reporting: A final report with an accounting of expenditures and a project summary, within 30 days of completion.

status.quote: Grant applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

applicant_types.quote: An official representative of the conservation organization should send an application

geography.quote: The CBC provides grants to support research, education and conservation of birds of the Carolinas and their habitats.

access.quote: Email completed applications or inquiries to: Grants Committee

window.quote: Grant applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

reporting.quote: Awardees must file a final report including an accounting of expenditures and a summary of the completed project no later than 30 days following its completion.
